title: Tremelimumab plus durvalumab versus sorafenib in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma
population: 1,171 patients randomized among STRIDE, durvalumab monotherapy and sorafenib.
treatment: STRIDE: tremelimumab 300 mg once plus durvalumab 1,500 mg every 4 weeks.
summary: Median OS 16.43 vs 13.77 months; HR 0.78 (96.02% CI 0.65–0.93; p=0.0035). Three-year OS 30.7% vs 20.2%. Grade 3–4 treatment-emergent AEs 50.5% vs 52.4%.

absoluteEffect.nnt: Approx. 10 at 3 years from fixed-time OS rates, not from median survival.
absoluteEffect.nnh: Not calculated without defensible fixed-time excess-harm risk.

clinicalInterpretation: STRIDE showed OS superiority over sorafenib. Durvalumab monotherapy was non-inferior, not superior, for OS; these comparisons must not be conflated. Consider hepatic reserve and immune-mediated hepatitis.
archiveNote: Previous Trial of the Day after 23 October 2026 rotation.
